_comment: Packages served at https://ohmybahgosh.dev/repo (Homebrew Channel repository). Add a repo here and the 'Homebrew repo' workflow picks up its latest release.  manifest = the manifest file attached to each GitHub release.  prerelease = true also accepts pre-releases (TiviBro's alpha builds).  No shortDescription = use the manifest's appDescription.

packages.shortDescription: Make a USB Ethernet adapter the TV's eth0, for the faster wired link
Install and manage Entware from the remote: Linux packages, a bash shell, and one-press add-ons like Tailscale, file sharing and Syncthing
